1.t: By the (Winds) sent forth one after another (to man's profit);

2.t: Which then blow violently in tempestuous Gusts,

4.t: Then separate them, one from another,

6.t: Whether of Justification or of Warning;-

7.t: Assuredly, what ye are promised must come to pass.

8.t: Then when the stars become dim;

9.t: When the heaven is cleft asunder;

10.t: When the mountains are scattered (to the winds) as dust;

11.t: And when the messengers are (all) appointed a time (to collect);-

12.t: For what Day are these (portents) deferred?

13.t: For the Day of Sorting out.

14.t: And what will explain to thee what is the Day of Sorting out?

15.t: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!

16.t: Did We not destroy the men of old (for their evil)?

17.t: So shall We make later (generations) follow them.

18.t: Thus do We deal with men of sin.

19.t: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!

20.t: Have We not created you from a fluid (held) despicable?-

21.t: The which We placed in a place of rest, firmly fixed,

22.t: For a period (of gestation), determined (according to need)?

23.t: For We do determine (according to need); for We are the best to determine (things).

24.t: Ah woe, that Day! to the Rejecters of Truth!

25.t: Have We not made the earth (as a place) to draw together.

27.t: And made therein mountains standing firm, lofty (in stature); and provided for you water sweet (and wholesome)?

28.t: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!

29.t: (It will be said:) "Depart ye to that which ye used to reject as false!

30.t: "Depart ye to a Shadow (of smoke ascending) in three columns,

31.t: "(Which yields) no shade of coolness, and is of no use against the fierce Blaze.

32.t: "Indeed it throws about sparks (huge) as Forts,

33.t: "As if there were (a string of) yellow camels (marching swiftly)."

34.t: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!

35.t: That will be a Day when they shall not be able to speak.

36.t: Nor will it be open to them to put forth pleas.

37.t: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!

38.t: That will be a Day of Sorting out! We shall gather you together and those before (you)!

39.t: Now, if ye have a trick (or plot), use it against Me!

40.t: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!

41.t: As to the Righteous, they shall be amidst (cool) shades and springs (of water).

42.t: And (they shall have) fruits,- all they desire.

43.t: "Eat ye and drink ye to your heart's content: for that ye worked (Righteousness).

44.t: Thus do We certainly reward the Doers of Good.

45.t: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!

46.t: (O ye unjust!) Eat ye and enjoy yourselves (but) a little while, for that ye are Sinners.

47.t: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!

48.t: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate yourselves!" they do not so.

49.t: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!

50.t: Then what Message, after that, will they believe in?
